skills/claude-statusbar.description: Manage `cs` (claude-statusbar) — switch the look (aurora blocks / aurora thin / classic) or density, override severity colors, preview the looks, run doctor, reset config, install, upgrade (`cs upgrade` — the only supported upgrade path), or remove the bar, toggle fast/daemon mode, show cost or prompt-cache age, or toggle the activity segments (todos, active tool, running subagents, session duration, lines changed, git ahead/behind).
